seoTitle: Make an Image Gallery or Slideshow on Squarespace
metaDescription: Build a photo gallery in Squarespace using grid, carousel, or slideshow layouts, with tips for choosing the right format.
intro: Whether you're showcasing a portfolio, a product line, or a photo collection, Squarespace offers several gallery formats to display images cleanly without any coding. This guide covers picking a layout and customizing it to match your site.

steps.heading: Log in and choose your site
steps.body: Sign in to Squarespace, using Continue with Google if linked, then select the site you want to edit and click Edit to enter customization mode.

steps.heading: Add an Images or Gallery section
steps.body: Click Add Section and scroll to the Images or Gallery section to see the available layout options.

steps.heading: Choose a gallery format
steps.body: Pick from grid, carousel, or slideshow gallery formats — slideshow works well for portfolios, while grid suits product showcases.

steps.heading: Add and arrange your images
steps.body: Drag and drop images from your computer or upload from your Squarespace image library, then reorder them and add titles or captions as needed.

steps.heading: Customize and save
steps.body: Adjust spacing, alignment, or animation effects using the gallery block settings, then click Save to publish it live.

faq.question: Which gallery layout should I choose?
faq.answer: A slideshow gallery works great for portfolios, while a grid layout is better suited to product showcases — explore the options to see what fits your content.

faq.question: Can I add captions to my gallery images?
faq.answer: Yes, you can add titles or captions to individual images as you arrange the gallery.

faq.question: Do I need to upload new images every time, or can I reuse past uploads?
faq.answer: If you've uploaded images before, they'll be available in your library to reuse without uploading again.

faq.question: Is coding required to build a gallery in Squarespace?
faq.answer: No, the built-in gallery block settings handle layout, spacing, and animation without any code.
